MICROSDXC FORMAT: XC format ensures support for large file sizes and extended capacity, ideal for 4K video recording and high-resolution photography.

description: The STORIX 64GB Micro SD Card is a reliable and high-performance storage solution designed to keep up with your fast-paced digital lifestyle. Rated Class 10 and U1, this microSDXC card delivers read speeds of up to 150MB/s, ensuring swift data transfers and smooth performance across a wide range of devices. Whether you are capturing stunning photos on your digital camera, recording surveillance footage on a CCTV system, shooting aerial videos with your drone, or simply expanding the storage on your smartphone or tablet, this card handles it all with ease. The XC (Extended Capacity) format provides ample 64GB of space to store thousands of photos, hours of video, and a vast library of apps and files. Its compact, industry-standard microSD form factor makes it compatible with a broad range of modern devices. Ideal for everyday users and tech enthusiasts alike, the STORIX Micro SD Card combines speed, capacity, and versatility in one dependable package. Please ensure your device supports the microSDXC format before purchasing.
